data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 names a contradiction relation with SRC_003 but does not articulate a causal mechanism for why the empirically detectable difference (perturbation/divergence-convergence patterns) arises or what mechanism makes it observable. It only asserts detectability of an outcome/process difference without stating the causal pathway that produces the observable divergence. The refuting condition is framed as empirical absence, not as the failure of a causal mechanism, so under the demand-a-causal-mechanism stance the relation remains a summary/observation rather than a mechanistic contradiction.
